name: Eid al-Fitr Holiday (Provisional) (Conditional: 30 Ramadan)
description: Provisional conditional holiday: this 2027-03-08 entry is placed one day before the current forecast of Eid al-Fitr on 2027-03-09. Under Cabinet Resolution 27/2024 Article 1, the additional holiday applies only when the officially confirmed month of Ramadan has 30 days, and it is 30 Ramadan. It does not apply if Ramadan has 29 days and is never a fourth day after 1–3 Shawwal. Moon-sighting confirmation may shift this date and the entire Eid window, or mean there is no extra day. Current Ramadan-start and Eid-start estimates imply 29 days and do not establish this conditional holiday; neither the date nor its applicability is confirmed.
